title: Distracting displays, alerts, and screen controls
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe infotainment, alerts, navigation visuals, and control methods as distracting or impractical while driving.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe distracting displays, intrusive sounds and notifications, awkward screen-menu dependence, and poorly performing voice controls that force manual interaction while driving.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention practicality in opposite directions, with one asking for faster operation for everyday use and another simply calling the feature practical.

limitations: The topic combines several interface-related issues, including navigation visuals, notification behavior, sounds, voice recognition, and screen-based controls, rather than one single feature.
Examples are brief fragments, so some feature references and context are insufficiently specific.
